Package be.imgn.gaia.events

@NullMarked package be.imgn.gaia.events
An event bus: EventBus, the Subscriptions it hands out, and @Subscribe for the methods of listeners, as are the annotations that @SubscribingAnnotation marks.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    be.imgn.gaia.events.spi
    The interface between EventBus and the code gaia-events-processor generates.
  • Class
    Description
    EventBus
    Delivers each event it is given to the subscribers of the event's class and of all its supertypes.
    EventBus.Builder
    Builds an EventBus.
    OnVirtualThread
    Subscribes a method as @Subscribe does, but has each of its events delivered on a new virtual thread, with VirtualThreadExecutor.
    Subscribe
    Marks a method that receives events once its listener is registered: the events of the type of its parameter, and of the subtypes of that type.
    SubscribingAnnotation
    Marks an annotation that subscribes the methods it annotates as @Subscribe does, and has the bus deliver their events through an executor, such as on a given thread.
    Subscription
    What EventBus.subscribe(Class, java.util.function.Consumer) or EventBus.register(Object) subscribed, until it is closed.
    VirtualThreadExecutor
    Runs each task on a new virtual thread: the executor of @OnVirtualThread.
